description: Shortlist LLMs on facts, no ranking: cloud models with the features you need within a monthly budget, cheapest first; or local models that fit your VRAM, largest first, with the ollama command. A shortlist is not a choice: only your own cases show which model fits.

features.description: Required features: vision, function_calling, json_mode, streaming, reasoning

max_budget.description: Maximum monthly budget in USD (based on tokens_per_day)

mode.description: cloud (API models) or local (Ollama/self-hosted). Default: cloud

quantization.description: Quantization (only for mode=local): Q4_K_M | Q8_0 | FP16. Default: Q4_K_M

use_case.description: Only "reasoning" filters (requires the feature); chatbot | code | rag | summarization | classification | agents | multilingual rank nothing

vram_gb.description: GPU VRAM in GB (only for mode=local). Default: 16

name: llm_fit_finder
